strategy.headline: MySivi scales 917 active ads by pairing cinematic AI-generated skits with a low-friction ₹1 trial offer.
executiveSummary: 917 active ads are currently live across five distinct Facebook pages
10 out of 10 sampled ads utilize Dynamic Creative to optimize delivery
8 out of 10 ads explicitly display the ₹1 price point on-screen
16 seconds is the median time for the first product UI appearance

winnerWhy.evidence: Ad 946551737840774 achieves a hook score of 8/10 with its mountain biking visual
The ₹1 trial offer is explicitly shown on screen and mentioned in the spoken CTA
Visual overlays highlight 10M+ downloads and a 4.6-star rating

winnerSteal: Cinematic AI-generated scenarios to bridge surreal hooks into product utility
₹1 entry offer to minimize conversion friction in the initial trial phase
Localized Hinglish dialogue that mirrors natural peer-to-peer conversation
strategy.hookTakeaway: Curiosity hooks score highest in our framework, with ad 3045760135765697 reaching a 9/10. Surreal AI-generated scenarios outperform standard benefit hooks in capturing initial attention.
strategy.ctaTakeaway: All 10 sampled ads end with an 'Install now' button. Spoken CTAs like 'Abhi MySivi download karo' provide direct instructions in 7 out of 10 creatives.

concepts.name: The Interview Transformation
concepts.exploitsGap: None of the 10 ads use a before -> after transformation
concepts.hook: English ki wajah se rejection? Ab aur nahi.
concepts.hookEnglish: Rejection because of English? No more.
script: 0-3s: Split screen. Left side: Nervous candidate stuttering. Right side: Confident candidate speaking.
3-10s: Close up of MySivi app interface showing a 5-minute practice session.
10-20s: Right side candidate gets the job offer. Text: 3 din practice, ₹1 trial.
concepts.caption: Sirf ₹1 mein apni English sudharein aur career badhayein. Install now.
concepts.whyItCouldWork: Directly addresses the primary pain point of professional rejection.

concepts.name: The Coaching Class Comparison
concepts.exploitsGap: Only 2 of 10 ads use a comparison against alternatives
script: 0-3s: Person looking at a high-priced coaching bill vs. MySivi app on phone.
3-10s: Fast-cut demo of the AI conversation feature in Tamil interface.
10-20s: Text: No travel, no high fees. Just ₹1 for 3 days.
concepts.caption: English pesa kathuka coaching class thevai illai. MySivi iruku. Trial for ₹1.
concepts.whyItCouldWork: Uses price anchoring to make the ₹1 trial feel like an obvious choice.

concepts.name: The 3-Second UI Reveal
concepts.hook: Ee app tho English matladadam chala easy.
concepts.hookEnglish: Speaking English is very easy with this app.
script: 0-3s: Phone screen showing the 'Start Speaking' button being pressed.
3-10s: Real-time AI voice interaction demo in Telugu.
10-20s: Quick montage of different lesson topics (Office, Travel, Friends).
concepts.caption: Telugu lo English nerchukondi. ₹1 trial offer limited time matrame.
concepts.whyItCouldWork: Solves the late product reveal issue by showing the app immediately.

recommendations.why: The 16s median reveal is too slow for feed placements where users scroll quickly
Current ads focus on the process but ignore the visual proof of the result
The current sample is limited to three languages despite a massive 917 ad portfolio

recommendations.action: Introduce a real user testimonial track
